name: Murder at Homecoming
source:
It's up to you, a teen detective, to investigate the murder of the most popular girl in school after the cops refuse to look into it any further. 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Murder_at_Homecoming]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
在警察拒绝进一步调查学校最受欢迎女孩的谋杀案后，你作为一名青少年侦探，要调查这起谋杀案。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Murder_at_Homecoming]Choices Wikia[/url]]
